name: recruit-match-suite-fast
description: End-to-end recruitment matching toolkit on DingTalk Notable OpenAPI: resume intake (with OCR backfill), job intake with JD semantic write-back, threshold-gated matching with per-job AI analysis, AI three-column resume deep parsing, candidate query, recruit dashboard, cross-org table replication, and the recruit data model knowledge base.
descriptionEn: End-to-end recruitment matching toolkit on DingTalk Notable OpenAPI: resume intake (with OCR backfill), job intake with JD semantic write-back, threshold-gated matching with per-job AI analysis, AI three-column resume deep parsing, candidate query, recruit dashboard, cross-org table replication, and the recruit data model knowledge base.
descriptionZh: 基于钉钉 AI 表格 OpenAPI 直连的招聘智能匹配套件：简历入库（含 OCR 补录）、岗位 JD 入库与语义回写、门槛前置匹配与逐岗 AI 分析、简历 AI 三列精析、候选人查询、招聘看板、跨组织表结构复制，以及招聘数据模型知识库。
